clue.text: High flier dishing up a nut-roast

indicators.note: a cook dishing up a roast serves it in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vegetarian cook serves a nut roast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dishing up' rearranges NUTROAST to STRONAUT, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone travelling into space flies higher than anyone, a playful description of a space traveller.

clue.text: Offend a large number in Pakistan

definitions.note: the definition reads as 'a place in Pakistan', a noun

parts.note: to offend against a moral law is to sin
D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number

explanation.surface: Someone causes offence to a great many people in Pakistan.
explanation.definitionFit: Sind (Sindh) is a province of southern Pakistan, so it is a region found there.

clue.text: Not too well aster being in collision with a car

definitions.text: being in collision with a car
definitions.meaning: knocked over by a motor vehicle, as a pedestrian may be

explanation.surface: Someone is feeling poorly after being hit by a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' joins the two definitions; the scan's 'aster' is an OCR slip for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Run-down means tired and in poor health, and to be run down is to be knocked over by a vehicle.

clue.text: Bound to make changes!

indicators.note: the two words are told to change, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something is certain to be altered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make changes' rearranges BOUNDTO; 'Bound' also hints at the meaning, certain.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is bound to happen is saying it is certain, beyond question.

clue.text: Where some of the Politburo discuss reconstruction

indicators.note: only part of the following words is taken, the letters sitting inside them

explanation.surface: Communist officials talk about perestroika.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some of' points to the letters running across 'discuss reconstruction'. The definition is really 'Where ... the Politburo' sat, the old Soviet state, so the clue is close to an all-in-one.
explanation.definitionFit: The Politburo was the ruling committee of the Soviet Union's Communist Party, so that state is where it met.

clue.text: Make tentative enquiries which dismay the sensitive

parts.note: to put someone out is to upset or dismay them
people who are sensitive are those who feel, playfully 'feelers'

explanation.surface: Probing questions can upset touchy people.
explanation.definitionFit: Antennae probe the surroundings, so the idiom means sounding out opinion cautiously.

clue.text: Climax of the wedding service forming a bond between him and her!

parts.note: each of these words is a part of speech standing in for a noun
cement is what binds things together, a bond

explanation.surface: The high point of a wedding joins husband and wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forming' and 'between' are link words; the bond comes after the grammatical term.
explanation.definitionFit: The ceremony's high point is the officiant's declaration that the couple are man and wife.

clue.text: The passion of a pyromaniac

parts.note: an intense longing, read literally as the fire-raiser's urge to set things alight

explanation.definitionFit: An ardent craving, and literally the arsonist's wish to set fires.

clue.text: Appeal by one gentleman who regrets his engagement?

parts.note: to call is to appeal or cry out
I is the Roman numeral one
a toff is British slang for an upper-class gentleman

explanation.surface: A gentleman sorry he proposed makes a plea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link word. The definition is cryptic: someone regretting being engaged would end it.
explanation.definitionFit: To call something off is to cancel it, which is what a reluctant fiancé would do with an engagement.

clue.text: The odds are on literacy becoming more dispersed

parts.note: SP is the starting price, the odds on a horse as a race begins
reading is the core skill of literacy

explanation.surface: Bookmakers bet on literacy rates rising.
explanation.definitionFit: Spreading means scattering or extending over a wider area.

clue.text: A French veto is not acknowledged

parts.note: non is French for no, a veto

explanation.surface: A French refusal goes ignored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link word. ANON is short for anonymous.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon, short for anonymous, marks a work whose author is unnamed and uncredited.

clue.text: Excess payment needed on getting into the coach

indicators.note: boarding a vehicle puts one word inside the other

parts.note: a coach is a long-distance bus

explanation.surface: An extra fee is charged for boarding the coach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needed' is a link word; 'getting into' puts ON inside BUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonus is extra money paid beyond the normal wage.

clue.text: Dash to use the camera

explanation.surface: Someone rushes to take a picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dash' looks like a verb meaning rush; it is a mild oath.
explanation.definitionFit: Snap! can be a cry of irritation like 'drat', and to snap is to take a photograph.

clue.text: Piece of furniture I had lifted onto the truck

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising a word reads it from the bottom upwards

parts.note: I'd is the contraction of 'I had'
a van is a small goods truck

explanation.surface: Someone loaded a sofa into a lorry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifted' turns ID to DI; 'onto' is a link word, DI sitting above VAN in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A divan is a low couch or bed, an item of furnishing.

clue.text: Discovery about Eastern demon

indicators.note: one word goes round another, as 'about' means surrounding

parts.note: a find is a discovery

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a demon from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts FIND around E.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiend is an evil spirit or devil.

clue.text: Disinclined to meet a Scotsman in Scotland

definitions.note: read as 'a region in Scotland', a noun

parts.note: loth means reluctant or disinclined
Ian is a typically Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A reluctant Scot meets another in Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to meet' is a link phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Lothian is a historic region around Edinburgh in south-east Scotland.

clue.text: Socialist group representative of people in Rome

definitions.meaning: the left-wing group of Labour MPs in Britain bearing a newspaper's name
an official elected to protect the interests of the Roman plebeians

explanation.surface: A left-wing faction is compared to an ancient Roman official.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tribune Group was a left-wing faction of Labour MPs, named after a socialist weekly.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tribune Group was a left-wing Labour caucus, and in ancient Rome a tribune defended the plebeians.

clue.text: Digital component occasioning unusual elation

indicators.note: the word is presented in an unusual form, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A computer part provokes surprising joy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occasioning' is a link word; 'unusual' rearranges ELATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Digits are fingers and toes, so a nail on a digit is part of one.

clue.text: Instrumentalists need a year in chivalrous contests

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: the lists were the arena for medieval jousting tournaments
YR is the abbreviation for year

explanation.surface: Musicians need a year of training in knightly tournaments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'need' is a link word; 'in' puts YR inside LISTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Lyrists are players of the lyre, a stringed musical instrument.

clue.text: Fellows who can't get service become intimidated

parts.note: men are fellows
in tennis a player aced cannot touch the serve at all

explanation.surface: Diners who are not served become angry and threatening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'become' is a link word. 'service' suggests a restaurant; it is a tennis serve.
explanation.definitionFit: Menaced means threatened, so a person who is intimidated feels it.

clue.text: Where muezzins are to be found in brand-new housing

indicators.note: one word holds the other inside it as a house holds people

parts.note: in mint condition means brand-new

explanation.surface: Muezzins are found in a newly built home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be found in' is a link phrase; the definition is really 'Where muezzins are', the word 'are' doing a double duty in spirit. 'housing' puts ARE inside MINT.
explanation.definitionFit: Muezzins call Muslims to prayer from the tall tower of a mosque.

clue.text: Take a trip in October?

definitions.meaning: the American season of autumn, which includes October

explanation.surface: Someone goes on holiday in the autumn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trip' suggests a journey; it is a stumble. Americans call autumn by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: To trip is to lose one's footing and tumble, and in American English autumn is the season of leaves dropping.

clue.text: Make a mark

definitions.meaning: a make is a manufacturer's label, as in a make of car

explanation.definitionFit: A brand is a trade name or make of goods, and also an identifying mark burned on an animal.

clue.text: Sign nothing in front of people

indicators.note: the first piece comes before the second in the answer

parts.note: O is the round figure zero, nothing
men are people

explanation.surface: Someone signs nothing in front of witnesses.
explanation.definitionFit: An omen is a portent, a sign of what is to come.

clue.text: A shade despondent

definitions.meaning: a colour, like sky or navy

explanation.surface: A colour that feels gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue is a colour, and feeling blue means being low in spirits.

clue.text: He invented the telephone buzzer

definitions.meaning: Alexander Graham, the Scottish-born inventor credited with the first telephone
a device that rings to signal, such as a doorbell

explanation.surface: The telephone's inventor also made the doorbell.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexander Graham Bell patented the telephone, and a bell is a ringing signal device like a buzzer.

clue.text: He gives marching orders to materials worker

parts.note: drill is a strong twilled cotton fabric
serge is a hard-wearing woollen cloth, used for uniforms
a worker ant is the commonest crossword worker

explanation.surface: A textile worker is given his notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'materials' gives two fabrics, DRILL and SERGE; 'to' is a link word. 'marching orders' suggests the sack; it means parade-ground commands.
explanation.definitionFit: A drill sergeant trains soldiers on the parade ground, barking commands to march.

clue.text: Tailpieces written in poetry are capable of many uses

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, as words are written in a book

parts.note: verse is poetry

indicators.note: the word is broken into pieces and reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: Endings in poems can serve many purposes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tailpieces' splits as TAIL plus 'pieces', which rearranges it to ATIL; 'written in' puts that inside VERSE. 'are' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Versatile means adaptable, able to be put to a wide range of purposes.
